import Header from './components/Header'
import Footer from './components/Footer'
import { Container } from 'react-bootstrap'

import { BrowserRouter as Router, Route,Link } from 'react-router-dom'

import LoginScreen from './screens/LoginScreen';
import RegisterScreen from './screens/RegisterScreen';
import ProfileScreen from './screens/ProfileScreen';
import PrivateRoute from './utils/PrivateRoute';
import HomeScreen from './screens/HomeScreen'
import BillScreen from './screens/BillScreen';
import UploadScreen from './screens/UploadScreen';
import consumptionCoefficientScreen from './screens/consumptionCoefficientScreen'
import demandCoefficientScreen from './screens/demandCoefficientScreen'
import barCoefficientScreen from './screens/barCoefficientScreen'
import barAverageCoefficientScreen from './screens/barAverageCoefficientScreen'
import barLimitCoefficientScreen from './screens/barLimitCoefficientScreen'
import barCompensationCoefficientScreen from './screens/barCompensationCoefficientScreen'
import barCompensationCoefficientActiveScreen from './screens/barCompensationCoefficientActiveScreen'
import MaximunDemandScreen from './screens/MaximunDemandScreen'
import UploadWaterScreen from './screens/UploadWaterScreen'
function App() {
  return (
    <Router>
      <Header/>
      <main>
          <Route path='/' component={HomeScreen} exact  />
          <Route path='/login' component={LoginScreen} />
          <Route path='/register' component={RegisterScreen} />
          <PrivateRoute path='/profile' component={ProfileScreen} />
          <Route path='/bill/:id' component={BillScreen} />
          <Route path='/upload' component={UploadScreen} />
          <Route path='/uploadwater' component={UploadWaterScreen} />
          <Route path='/consumptionCoefficient' component={consumptionCoefficientScreen} />
          <Route path='/demandCoefficient' component={demandCoefficientScreen}/>
          <Route path='/barCoefficient' component={barCoefficientScreen}/>
          <Route path='/baraverageCoefficient' component={barAverageCoefficientScreen}/>
          <Route path='/barLimitCoefficient' component={barLimitCoefficientScreen}/>
          <Route path='/barCompensationCoefficient' component={barCompensationCoefficientScreen}/>
          <Route path='/barCompensationCoefficientActive' component={barCompensationCoefficientActiveScreen}/>
          <Route path='/MaximunDemand' component={MaximunDemandScreen}/>

      </main>
      <Footer />
    </Router>
  );
}

export default App;
